detailed_descriptions.en: Nocturnal 2 is an atmospheric action adventure game that invites you to explore the dark depths and towering heights of the city of Ytash. Features Explore an interconnected city, discover hidden passages, and unlock new paths with new abilities. Use your flaming sword to fight enemies and bring fire back to the city. Enjoy fast, fluid movement and responsive combat. Discover a hand-drawn world inspired by Persian architecture. Gather strange arcana and poems that may lead you down unexpected paths.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Nocturnal 2 is an atmospheric action adventure game that invites you to explore the dark depths and towering heights of the city of Ytash.

Features

  • Explore an interconnected city, discover hidden passages, and unlock new paths with new abilities.

  • Use your flaming sword to fight enemies and bring fire back to the city.

  • Enjoy fast, fluid movement and responsive combat.

  • Discover a hand-drawn world inspired by Persian architecture.

  • Gather strange arcana and poems that may lead you down unexpected paths.
